name: A plain prompt right after a reaction gets a small face in silence
judge: Boop has just cheered one agent's finish, and a minute later the person plainly asks another agent to run tests. Nothing stands out, so Boop shouldn't make a fuss.
reasonable: A pleased finish first. At the plain request, nothing, or a small brief face. A tiny sound is forgivable.
unreasonable: A big moment, a loud speech or a showy sign at the plain request, or a finish animation there.
